sections.Profile:
A-Go-Go, released by Williams Electronic Manufacturing Company in May 1966, is a four-player electro-mechanical pinball machine with a dance and music theme. Designed by Norm Clark, the game features four flippers, three pop bumpers, two slingshots, four stand-up targets, and a kick-out hole. The machine's vibrant artwork, created by Jerry Kelley, captures the energetic spirit of the 1960s dance scene.
